course.name: Crystal Academy
course.tagline: Live options and futures trading sessions, structured education and psychology coaching from Sierra Smith.
course.about: Crystal Academy is a trading education community founded by Sierra Smith in 2023, focused on options and futures trading. It combines daily live trading sessions, structured lessons and trading psychology coaching, with a free Basic tier and a paid Diamond membership for full access.

formats.label: Daily study groups
formats.description: Ongoing study groups alongside the live sessions.

formats.label: Weekly educational classes
formats.description: Structured weekly lessons covering the core curriculum.

formats.label: Community & library
formats.description: 24/7 library access and a private Discord-based community.

pricing.name: Basic
pricing.billing_note: Free education and community chat access, including free Friday sessions.

testimonials.quote: The live trading sessions have completely transformed my approach. Real-time guidance makes all the difference.
testimonials.author: Michael R.
testimonials.source: Quoted on Crystal Academy's website (described as a day trader)

testimonials.quote: The psychology coaching alone is worth the membership. I've finally developed the discipline I needed.

testimonials.source: Quoted on Crystal Academy's website (described as an options trader)

testimonials.quote: As a beginner, the study groups and library access helped me learn faster than I ever thought possible.
testimonials.author: Emily L.
testimonials.source: Quoted on Crystal Academy's website (described as a new trader)

_notes.source: crystalacademytrades.com homepage (its other pages — /about, /faq, /mentorship, /results — are rendered client-side and returned no content to a direct fetch); no Trustpilot profile exists for this domain (confirmed, 404); Whop rating/review count averaged across several search snapshots (4.8-4.82, ~3,100-3,500 reviews) since Whop's own pages are JS-rendered and didn't expose exact current numbers to a fetch. Founder's name given as Sierra Smith (as provided); some third-party sources instead call her Sierra Aaliyah (her Whop handle is sierraaaliyah) — not independently resolved.
